analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold from 39.2 to 53.7. MACD histogram improving from -8.6128 to -2.9719. Weekly RSI at 64.3 indicates a bullish zone. ADX at 13.5 suggests a weak trend, but recent 4-hour RSI at 54.4 aligns with an uptrend.
